notes: needs ruling: this is a route statement («طريق») for the compiler's books, not a report with a saying; the four «و»-routes to Muʿawiya ibn ʿAmmār are read as four groups, and it is not settled how the «جميعا» joins (Hmyri, Ibn Abi ʿUmayr) should converge
«ويكنّى أبا القاسم» is a kunya remark, not a link; «رضي الله عنهما» is left out
